eog-cutler-rd.name: EOG Cutler Rd pads - Ditka, Lambeau, Shula (Sherrodsville, Warren Twp, Tuscarawas Co)

rules.t: CUTLER RD: 25 MPH MAX, no exceptions - from SR 39 up to the Oak Dale Rd intersection, and again once you pass the Lambeau lease road.
rules.from: EOG vendor call 11/12/2026; where it applies: Rick 11/14/2026 (EOG clarification)

rules.t: OAK DALE RD INTERSECTION (Cutler Rd & Oak Dale Rd): EOG-controlled. Stop signs are covered and a flagger is on site. Slow-roll through at 10 MPH on the flagger's signal. The 10 MPH zone starts here.
rules.from: EOG vendor call 11/12/2026 (called "Oakmont" on the call); Cutler Rd & Oak Dale Rd and 10 MPH slow-roll: Rick 11/14/2026 (EOG clarification)
